title: Certified Phase Atlases for Biological ODE Models
consensus_strengths: Tiered certification architecture (interval arithmetic → dReal δ-complete → Z3 exact) provides graceful degradation with at least one independent verification path for every regime claim.
Certificate composition calculus (B2) with soundness-preserving hierarchical composition and boundary certificate requirements solves a practical proof-management problem.
Milestone 0 dReal feasibility benchmarking with explicit decision gates demonstrates unusually honest engineering methodology.
Taylor-model interval arithmetic exploiting biological positivity constraints avoids division-by-zero singularities — a non-trivial specialization of validated numerics.
Multi-paper research program with clear venue targets (CAV/TACAS, JCD, PLOS Comp Bio) reflects mature academic planning.
consensus_weaknesses: Dimensional limitations (n ≤ 6 equilibria, n ≤ 3 periodic orbits, p ≤ 4 systematic coverage) restrict applicability to small biological models.
GP surrogate for adaptive exploration is underspecified: kernel selection, acquisition function, cold-start strategy, and comparison against non-ML baselines are missing.
δ parameter selection for biological relevance is unformalized; the mapping from δ-perturbation to biological meaningfulness is domain-specific and underspecified.
Composition of δ-perturbation (dReal) and interval-enclosure (Krawczyk) error sources creates compounded approximation whose tracking in certificates is not specified.
Near-bifurcation regions where Jacobians are nearly singular pose challenges for both Krawczyk certification and SMT encoding.
actionable_recommendations: Formalize δ-selection criteria providing explicit bounds on δ sufficient for biologically meaningful regime classification.
Either specify the GP surrogate completely (kernel, acquisition function, cold-start) with baseline comparisons, or replace with simpler adaptive mesh refinement heuristics.
Analyze and document how δ-perturbation and interval-enclosure errors compose in the certificate format.
Prioritize Milestone 0 benchmarking to establish realistic scalability limits before committing to the full pipeline.
